item.description:
Promptr Studio Pro 6.7

New

  • Bring any file into a project. Drag files and folders from Finder onto a project, folder or the gallery. They are copied into the project folder; PDFs and text files appear in the gallery, everything else in a new Files strip.
  • Paul reads your documents. Give him a PDF, Word, text or CSV file and talk it through.
  • Paul knows the VFX tools. Ask him to turn a vertical clip into 16:9 and he sets up LTX Reframe, shows the price and waits for your go.
  • Kling O3 multi-shot. Up to six shots with their own prompt and length in one clip.
  • Several images per job. GPT Image and Seedream 5.0 create up to four images at once. Seedream images can take a seed.

Improved

  • Deleted cloud folders stay deleted. Your choice when leaving or deleting now applies on all your Macs, and hidden cloud folders stay hidden everywhere.
  • Paul stays in your language, also after generating.
  • Image edits use Seedream 5.5 by default, in Paul and in inpainting, unless you pick another model.
  • Gallery. Faster paging, a running card opens the preview, dragging a cloud asset fetches the original, and Copy job ID in the menu.

Promptr Studio Pro 6.6

New

  • Seedance 2.5 Flash. ByteDance's fast video model: close to Seedance 2.5 in quality, about twice as fast and cheaper. 480p or 720p, 4 to 30 seconds, with start and end frames or up to ten images, five videos and five audio clips as references.

Promptr Studio Pro 6.5

New

  • 3D objects from text. Describe an object in the 3D Scene Composer and get it as a 3D model, placed in your scene.
  • Poly Haven library. Search free CC0 models under Add and place them at real-world size.
  • Meshy 7.1. The quality tier for 3D models now keeps small details.

Improved

  • Leaner 3D Scene Composer. Simpler panels, assets grouped in the settings panel and a slimmer object library.
  • Switch modes from the 3D Scene Composer. Go to Studio, Agent or Nodes without closing it first.
  • Up to 150 objects per scene.
